correctness.rationale: From the exact lattice resolvent and rank-one killing, a renewal calculation gives T(q,kappa). Differentiating shows P(q) with one coefficient sign change, P(0)<0<P(1), hence one simple root and unique global optimum. The factorization T=U+V/kappa and strictly increasing U/V locates the root between perfect-absorber and reaction-resistance optima and gives dq/dkappa<0, dr/dkappa>0. The explicit m=1 root yields r* asymptotic sqrt(kappa). All assumptions and boundaries are checked, with 1949 independent finite-grid algebraic/numerical assertions supporting but not replacing proof.

value.rationale: It resolves a natural singularity in the 2025 perfectly absorbing lattice first-passage result: every finite trap reaction rate regularizes the nearest-neighbor infinite optimal reset into a finite unique one, and the crossover exponent and prefactor are exact. Uniqueness and strict reaction-rate calibration for all integer separations expose a physically relevant structural rule, distinct from routine numerical minimization and not supplied by a mean expression alone.
